newsitem.title: FRANCE: Ex-French defence minister Giraud dies.
newsitem.headline: Ex-French defence minister Giraud dies.

text.p: Former French defence and industry minister Andre Giraud has died at the age of 72 after a long illness, the Gaullist RPR party said on Monday.
Giraud, who died on Sunday, was defence minister in 1986-1988 when President Jacques Chirac was prime minister.
Industry minister between 1978 and 1981 and a longtime senior official of France's Atomic Energy Commission, Giraud began his political career in 1949.
